description: A blank panel carrying the Patch & Tweak name and a quotation from Lady Starlight, with a hidden jack that spins its ampersand

inputs.text: Turns the red ampersand of the Patch & Tweak logo, a full turn for every 10V and the other way for negative voltage; the turn is held to a little over three revolutions a second

notes: the jack is drawn invisibly, so there is nothing on the panel to aim at, but a cable dropped on the spot takes hold and a patched cable shows against the artwork
the panel passes no audio and puts nothing out; the only thing it does is turn the ampersand in time with whatever you patch
